prompt: Players report that after saving and reloading, their inventory is occasionally wrong - items swap slots or a stack count is off by one. I can't reproduce it locally. I'm tempted to just re-sort the inventory on load to hide it.
assertions: Rejects re-sorting on load as a symptom-masking workaround
Treats 'cannot reproduce' as the first task: requests or constructs a failing save file and builds a save/load round-trip reproduction
Makes the reproduction deterministic, e.g. fixed seed and repeated save-load cycles, and compares saved state to loaded state
Distinguishes whether it is a data bug (specific save file) or logic bug (all saves) by testing with different data
Identifies a concrete serialization root cause such as unordered dictionary/collection iteration, an unserialized field, or version mismatch, with evidence
Applies a minimal fix to the serialization logic rather than patching the loaded result
Verifies by round-tripping the previously failing save and checking old save files still load correctly
